name: Kaunertal Glacier Concert
beschreibung: An open-air concert on the Kaunertaler Gletscher at 3,000 metres altitude! International DJs and live bands perform under the open sky as the sun sets behind the glacier peaks. The spectacular glacier lift whisks guests up to the highest event stage in Austria.
kurzbeschreibung: Open-air concert on the Kaunertaler Gletscher – musical bliss at an altitude of 3,000 metres.
